question: How much did full few-shot help, and what failures remain?
takeaway: 71 gains, 11 losses, 178 tasks wrong in both runs.
metric: Correct tasks divided by all released test tasks per dataset; macro gives each dataset equal weight.
missingness: Every task has both boolean outcomes; missing outcomes would stop analysis.
privacy: Only aggregate counts, no question, answer or prediction text.
text_alternative: No memory macro 28.97%; Full few-shot macro 43.16%. +14.19 percentage points, paired 95% interval [10.24, 18.23]. See the companion CSV for all counts.
